features.quote: Cap at a fixed max tool calls (e.g. 30). Degradation is per-turn; you want it comparable across runs.
features.justification_quote: Degradation is per-turn; you want it comparable across runs.

features.quote: A legitimate exit must exist. The agent should always be *able* to stop and report "I believe this is unsolvable because X."
features.justification_quote: If there's no sanctioned giving-up move, you're measuring the harness's refusal to let the model quit, not the model.

features.quote: If you build tasks where failure is *guaranteed by a broken harness*, you'll get a high "reproduction rate" — but you won't know what you've reproduced.
features.justification_quote: you'll have confounded three different things... a naive degradation judge scores them identically.
